title: Where the Sand Settles
idea: Moving water drops a grain where it gets too slow to carry it, so the biggest grains drop first and the place water slows is where sediment piles up.

serves.objective: SCI004-02-c: explain that water drops its sediment where it slows down, the largest grains first, by setting the flow and the land and running the stream

stream.title: From the hills to the lake

rules.label: Sand carried out to the lake

draft.prompt: Rain sets how fast the stream runs. Set the stream so the pebbles stay in the hills and the sand settles on the flat.

help.says: Water drops a grain where it gets too slow to move it, and the water slows down on the flat.

add_stimulus.text: A grain keeps moving while the water is at least as fast as the speed that moves it.

simplify.says: I slowed the stream part of the way.

draft.why: The child finds a speed window: fast enough to carry sand, too slow for pebbles, and slow enough on the flat for the sand to drop there.

draft.prompt: A storm is coming. Before it runs: what is the slowest stream speed in the hills that carries the sand all the way out to the lake?

help.says: The sand has to keep moving on the flat, and the water there is slower than in the hills.

add_stimulus.text: Speed on the flat = speed in the hills − {{slow}}

simplify.says: One of these speeds is out.

draft.why: The child predicts from the rule before running it: the sand reaches the lake only if it is still fast enough after the flat slows it.

draft.prompt: Test your answer. Make the sand reach the lake, but keep the pebbles in the hills.

help.says: Work out the speed on the flat: the sand needs to still be moving there.

add_stimulus.text: Speed on the flat = speed in the hills − {{slow}}

simplify.says: I sped the stream up part of the way.

draft.why: The child runs the prediction on the same stream and sees where the sand lands; the pebbles stay put, so the window has a top as well as a bottom.

draft.prompt: A flood: the stream runs at {{flood}} and the rain will not stop. Change the land instead: make the sand settle on the flat and not wash into the lake.

help.says: The water drops sand where it gets slower than the speed that moves sand. A wider, flatter stretch slows it more.

simplify.says: I widened the flat part of the way.

draft.why: The other half of deposition: when the flow cannot change, changing where the water slows (the land) decides where the sediment drops.
